description: Java class ArtworkLoader for loading and caching media artwork images, with methods for retrieving, cropping, and handling asynchronous downloads.

classes.name: ArtworkLoader
classes.description: Handles loading, caching, and processing of media artwork images.

classes.name: ArtworkLoader.Callback
classes.description: Interface for callback when artwork is loaded.

methods.name: getOrLoadArtwork
methods.description: Returns cached artwork or initiates download if not available.

methods.name: getBestFitImage
methods.description: Selects the media image that best fits the display size.

methods.name: cropTo16x9
methods.description: Crops a bitmap to a 16:9 aspect ratio.

methods.name: onDownloadFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of artwork download, updates cache, and triggers callback.
